old.keyboard: ONE tab stop for the whole tree (roving tabindex). Down and up move through everything currently visible; right expands a closed branch or steps into an open one; left collapses an open branch or steps out to its parent; Home and End go to the first and last visible node; Enter and Space select; the asterisk key expands every branch at the focused level; a letter key jumps to the next visible node whose label starts with it, wrapping.
old.pointer: Clicking the twisty toggles the branch. Clicking anywhere else on the row selects the node. The twisty is aria-hidden decoration, not a second control — keyboard users never need it.
old.visibility: 'Visible' is computed as offsetParent !== null, which is exactly the question 'is any ancestor collapsed', rather than a parallel model that can drift from the DOM.
old.lazy: First open sets aria-busy, swaps the group for skeleton bones, and replaces them with real treeitems when the children arrive. The bones are role=none so they never enter the tree's item set.
